8.17. iLock_Geography.geo2pispec¶

The module defines the class PiSPECGenerator which is used to instantiate PiSPEC from geo types and populate PiSPEC parameters from geo predicates.

Classes

PiSPECGenerator(predicateManager[, …]) Return an object used to instantiate PiSPEC and populate parameters.
